W6 after E061. Time ≈ 0.1 s fixed + steps × per-step cost. Per-step cost has a pixel-proportional compute part and a bandwidth/elementwise part (BN/GELU, ~27% of a 32 px step). The tip is E061: 5.0235 s, 0.7534 on seeds 0–2 (225 steps). It beat my forecast: removing 12 early 20 px steps saved about 0.15 s, more than the 0.07 s I expected. Same-commit rebuilds read about ±0.03 s in time. The 3-seed accuracy mean moves about ±0.2 pp across rebuilds. E049's builds read 0.7535, 0.7552 and 0.7536.

Mechanisms, with supporting experiments:
1. Accuracy rises slowly with optimizer steps, about 0.8–2.5 s/pp. Step, epoch and sample cuts trade near that dial (E020, E031, E040, E041, E045, E048, E061). My miss on E061: early 20 px steps are cheap in accuracy, and the seed-set winner's curse had inflated the earlier E041 loss.
2. Early low resolution is nearly free (E026, E033). The 32 px tail carries accuracy (E011, E018, E024).
3. Late backward truncation saves more than its MAC share. A frozen block also skips BN/GELU backward, optimizer traffic and Lookahead traffic (E028, E036, E046, E049). It is free only after the block's learning has finished (H7). Group 1 needs 32 px exposure (E037, E054, E055).
4. Activation cost is partly compute-bound. ReLU saved 0.25 s but lost 0.54 pp (E056). Smoothness matters.
5. Averaging variants, LS changes, warm-up, Lookahead interval and BN recalibration are null or negative (E025, E029, E030, E032, E044). wd ×0.5 gave about +0.2 pp. The recipe is near a local optimum.
6. Architecture surgery on high-resolution work (E051) loses more than it saves.
7. Build noise and the seed-set winner's curse (0.1–0.2 pp) dominate every decision under 0.15 pp. The unselected population mean is about 0.752–0.754, so the margin over 0.75 is thin.
8. Time forecasts: the tip sits near 5.02–5.18 s depending on build. Trims below 1% are not visible in wall time.

Unsure: the true rebuild SD, whether coarse labels are usable (likely not, since TrainingData has only fine labels), PCIe transfer, and whether Muon beats SGD on CIFAR-100.

Expectations: I096 loses 0.2–0.5 pp for a small time saving, so it likely refutes. I097 gives under 1.5% saving and closes, or tanh-GELU is neutral. I098 saves about 0.05 s and is roughly neutral to slightly negative in accuracy.

forecasts.reason: SGD on filters likely loses accuracy versus Muon (E006 gain, short-run conv). NS saving is only about 0.2 s total.
Tanh-GELU or SiLU probably saves under 1.5%, so the gate likely closes the branch with no run. If it runs, accuracy is neutral.
Fewer early steps cost roughly the dial's rate, and the per-step overhead saving is small. The net effect is near the noise.

cruxes: Is rebuild SD of the 20-seed mean really near 0.05 pp or 0.1–0.2 pp? This sets which sub-0.15 pp trims can be kept.
Is the population mean on fresh seeds at least 0.7515, or is it near 0.7500 with a thin margin? This decides how much more time can be cut.
Do early-phase (20 px) steps keep being nearly free, so the trims continue beyond 225 steps?
